items.name: date-input
items.title: Date input
items.description: Native date, datetime-local, month, week and time input in the YoRHa control surface (type prop, min/max/step) inside a Field, with an optional button that opens the Calendar in the Popover for type=date.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Pick the control with `type` (date, datetime-local, month, week, time); values use the native formats. `picker` adds a calendar button for type=date only; Escape or picking a day closes the popup and returns focus to the button. min and max also disable days in the calendar. Set lang on the wrapper for CJK leading.
